# Preface {.unnumbered}

This document is the Supplementary Data S1 of the article
*GraphExperiment: infrastructure for high-dimensional quantitative data and
associated networks in R/Bioconductor*. It contains the use cases
described in the article, with all code needed to reproduce them. Code and
data are also available at
<https://github.com/almeidasilvaf/GraphExperiment_paper>.

__GraphExperiment__ [@almeida2026graphexperiment] extends the
`SingleCellExperiment` class with two new slots: `rowGraphs`, which stores
graphs describing how features (e.g., genes, proteins, taxa) relate to each
other, and `colGraphs`, which stores graphs describing how observations
(e.g., samples, cells, cell types, species) relate to each other. Here, we
demonstrate how __GraphExperiment__ can be used with different omics data
types through a series of short use cases, written in the style of
package vignettes. All use cases use small example data sets distributed
with other R/Bioconductor packages, and they can be run on a laptop.

| Use case | Data type | Graphs | Slot |
|:---------|:----------|:-------|:-----|
| 1 | Bulk RNA-seq (maize tissues) | Gene coexpression and regulatory networks | `rowGraphs` |
| 2 | Single-cell proteomics (EMT time course) | Protein co-abundance network; metacell kNN graph | `rowGraphs`, `colGraphs` |
| 3 | 16S rRNA amplicon sequencing (human skin) | Taxon association networks (SPIEC-EASI, SparCC); sample kNN graph | `rowGraphs`, `colGraphs` |
| 4 | scRNA-seq (mouse brain) | Cell-cell SNN and kNN graphs | `colGraphs` |
| 5 | scRNA-seq (human pancreas) | Cell type communication network | `colGraphs` |
| 6 | Comparative genomics (eudicots) | Phylogenetic profile similarity network; species graph from a phylogeny | `rowGraphs`, `colGraphs` |
| 7 | Comparative phenotypic data (*Xiphophorus*) | Species graphs from a tree and from a phylogenetic network | `colGraphs` |

: Use cases in this document. {tbl-colwidths="[10,32,42,16]"}

## Installation {.unnumbered}

To reproduce the analyses in this book, you will need to install the
following packages:

```{r}
#| eval: false

install.packages("BiocManager")
pkgs <- c(
    "remotes", "tidyverse", "ggraph", "patchwork", "here", "nipals",
    "GraphExperiment", "BioNERO", "scpdata", "QFeatures", "org.Hs.eg.db",
    "limma", "mia", "scater", "scuttle", "scrapper", "bluster", "scRNAseq",
    "syntenet", "ComplexHeatmap", "zdk123/SpiecEasi", "saezlab/liana"
)

BiocManager::install(pkgs)
```
